thread:
anya: Quick sync — we need a concrete plan for the multi-quant bring-up. Primary asks: holdout design, dedupe rules, golden updates, and labeler schedule. Can we finalize today?

mike: I can draft sampling criteria. Do we want stratified by token-length and lang?

anya: yes to both. Also need to avoid overlap with current eval holdouts. We'll use a strict fingerprint dedupe.

sara: heads up — last quant smoke showed weird score inversion on short prompts (<=16 tokens) vs fp16. That could be sampling bias. We should oversample short prompts in the holdout. :thinking_face:

jen: labeler capacity: I can spin up a 12-worker burst on the `quant_holdout` queue for 36h. Need the sample export by EOD.

mike: rough sampling SQL I ran locally:```sql
SELECT id, prompt, lang, length(tokens) as toklen
FROM prompt_bank
WHERE created_at < '2026-03-01'
AND quality_score >= 0.6
ORDER BY RANDOM()
LIMIT 5000;
```
We should stratify that into bins 0-16,17-64,65+.

anya: nice. Add a de-dup pass: fingerprint on normalized prompt + placeholder tokens. Anything with fingerprint collision to existing golden should be excluded. Use 90% similarity threshold for fuzzy matches.

labeler-bot: queued export job `export_quant_holdout_2167894321` created. ETA ~ 1h.

jen: ok once export ready I'll run: `./labeler assign --queue quant_holdout --workers 12 --ttl 36h`

mike: for golden set updates: proposal — only update golden after 2 independent labeler runs disagree and a third senior labeler adjudicates. Keep golden immutable during bring-up.

anya: agree. Also create a small fast-feedback slice (n=200) sampled from production traffic to run daily through quantized model — helps catch regressions early.

sara: will set up eval harness for that slice. We'll include ROUGE/BLEU-like metrics + the model-quality thresholds from the last SLO doc.

ops-bot: reminder: Dedicated infra maintenance window 2026-03-10 02:00-04:00 UTC — may affect long exports.

jen: noted. I'll avoid scheduling long labeler runs to overlap.

anya: action items: mike -> produce stratified export + dedupe script (due EOD). jen -> stand up workers after export. sara -> eval harness + daily fast-feedback slice. I'll own golden update policy and runbook for disagreements.

mike: on it.

sara: ETA for harness: tomorrow morning.

jen: will monitor labeler throughput and report backlog. :thumbsup:

anya: thanks all. Ping here when export completes. :eyes:
